quiz.q: How should you position your cybersecurity experience?
options: Say you have no relevant cybersecurity experience
State that your depth is FS and SW architecture and you are extending it into TARA and security architecture
quiz.why: This is consistent with the evidence in your application.

quiz.q: What is the core difference between HARA and TARA?
options: HARA is hardware; TARA is software
HARA addresses malfunction-related hazards; TARA addresses malicious threats
HARA is quantitative; TARA is qualitative
quiz.why: Their initiating risk sources differ, although both drive requirements and architecture.

quiz.q: Why is an HSM important at MCU level?
options: It provides a protected security domain for key material and cryptographic operations
It removes the need for secure boot
quiz.why: AURIX HSM provides an isolated security domain and hardware-supported security functions.

aurixQuickTraining.title: AURIX / TriCore and Security - 45-minute interview crash course
aurixQuickTraining.sourceNote: Use public Infineon product information for current device-specific details; this route teaches the architecture-level concepts needed for the interview.
triCore: TriCore is Infineon's 32-bit unified multi-core MCU/DSP architecture family, optimized for real-time embedded systems.
AURIX families include TC2x, TC3x and TC4x; TC3x/TC4x software ecosystems include AUTOSAR MCAL and safety-oriented software.
Interview mental model: CPU/execution + memory + peripherals + safety management + security domain + automotive software stack.
safety: Typical safety discussion: ECC and memory protection; watchdogs; execution monitoring/lockstep where applicable; error collection/management; diagnostic reporting.
Always connect mechanism -> fault class -> detection -> reaction -> evidence. MCU safety features do not by themselves establish vehicle-level functional safety.
Your bridge: AURIX/TriCore + AUTOSAR + EBS/braking architecture lets you explain how MCU mechanisms become system/software safety evidence.
security: AURIX security includes an embedded HSM security domain with protected key storage and hardware-assisted cryptography.
Public Infineon material describes features such as TRNG, AES acceleration, MAC-related capabilities and secure-boot support; exact feature sets vary by device/family.
Security mental model: root of trust -> secure boot -> protected keys/HSM -> secure communication/diagnostics -> secure update.
aurixQuickTraining.drawingExercise: Draw a block diagram from memory: TriCore CPUs, memory, peripherals, safety/error management, and an HSM trust boundary. Then trace one fault and one security event from detection to software reaction.
